notes: Boot elvis (5.00) with four balls on trough switches 11-14 and the stacking opto 15 at 0, built-in mechanisms off; public 64 starts at 0 like every other unlisted switch. Coin up twice, start a game and serve the ball as in elvis-gameplay. Then, twice, raise the hotel door 63 (a control) to 1 for 2.5 s and lower it for 2.5 s, and do the same with the hound dog 64, so each output the ROM fires can be timed against the rising or the falling level of that address.
